_doc: x_on_surge budget + fetch config (X Summarizer v0.4, 2026-10-18). Phase 3 = on-surge X recent search only (no filtered stream). Caps per Jeffrey: $5/day, $100/month, automatic stop. Runs on the mini with Jeffrey's existing X key. Schemas: SCHEMAS.md s9 v1.1 (file of 2026-10-18 18:08 PT). Reference logic: budget_guard.py, prefilter.py (xf-v1.1).
fetch_enabled_note: ON 2026-10-19 ~8:40 AM PT per Jeffrey go. Caps $5/day $100/month auto-stop. Phase 3 on-surge recent search only (no filtered stream). Kill: ~/oid-data/state/x/STOP

credentials.note: Path reference only, on the mini. The x_on_surge process reads it at startup; design code never reads, prints or logs it.

phase.filtered_stream: later phase; see stream-rules-draft.json (separate app or mini, tag-scoped deletes only). The box x_realtime.py and its rules are out of scope and untouched.

seal.rule: Config hash sealed after 2 trading days of Rose's live news_surge shakedown. Only surges whose surge fire time is after the seal count for evaluation; earlier rows are archived with proxy/pre-seal status and excluded.

lead_rule.leading_if: lead_s >= 60, lead_s = surge fire_ts - post created_at (s)
lead_rule.gold_labels: lead_ref fire_ts|bar_start; lead_status leading|lagging|unknown; proxy rows inside [bar_start-60s, bar_start+5min) = unknown (relevance/direction only, no timing metrics)

x_fetch_status_use.skipped:cap: 40 surge fetches or 120 requests per day reached
x_fetch_status_use.skipped:no_token: token file missing on the mini
x_fetch_status_use.skipped:recent: same symbol fetched within dedupe.reuse_if_last_fetch_within_s; post_query_hits rows attached with reused=true

pricing_assumption.billing_dedupe: X bills a post once per 24h UTC day (soft guarantee); budget_guard does NOT count on it (worst case).

caps.monthly_cap_resets: X billing-cycle start (OPEN: anchor date; default = 1st of calendar month 00:00 UTC until Jeffrey confirms)
caps.pacing: today_allowance = min(5.00, (100.00 - month_spent) / trading_days_left_in_cycle_incl_today). ~22 trading days -> $4.55 at cycle start; underspend rolls forward up to the $5.00 day cap.

stages_by_share_of_today_allowance.at_cap: skip: surges row x_fetch_status=skipped:budget; sweeps stop too; resume next PT day (daily) or next cycle (monthly)

crowd_query.user_lookup: two-stage: GET /2/users?ids= only for stage-1 survivors not in the 7-day user cache (<=100 ids, one request)

schema_tables_written: post_query_hits (PK post_id+fetch_id; source of truth; rank 1-based)
